purpose: Improve small rigid-object tracking and measured planar calibration on user local webcam; monitor grounded observations, not assert consciousness/semantic recognition.
priorInspection: Two640x480 setup frames viewed locally in memory, not saved/published: Cricut12x12in mat, dual-unit tape, black lighter placed right of tape between4and8 by user. Full mat top cropped. No numerical scale/error or tracking performance measured before declaration.

geometry.method: Four known visible mat-grid intersections define a subrectangle; exact corner coordinates/dimensions recorded before scoring. Fixed camera, mat-plane projection of object centre; object height/depth unknown.
geometry.check: Independent pairs of inch marks on tape, not used to fit homography; user confirmed both units. Preserve first pixel annotations/calibration/check result.
geometry.cameraChange: Static anchor patches/position consistency; degrade/recalibrate if anchors shift or no longer match, not silent rebase.

candidate.tracker: New versioned Java rigid-target anchor/template matcher with local/coarse-to-fine search, appearance/ambiguity/innovation gates, bounded reacquisition; old036/037 tracker/filter/native identities remain unchanged.
candidate.clock: Actual camera callback seconds; new constant-velocity prediction in seconds, metric plane projection, declared process/noise parameters and missing-measurement uncertainty.
candidate.rate: Bounded single-flight frame processing, nominal5Hz, no queue growth or invented times; original sampled frames stored locally with hashes.
candidate.scope: One human-seeded lighter per session; projected centre, rotation/occlusion limitations disclosed. User label is guidance, not automatic BIC/person/semantic recognition.

evaluation.development: Initial static setup and declared analytic controls; original037 known EPFL failures are seen regressions, not novel held footage.
evaluation.reserved: After committed candidate lock, a new physical sequence requested from user: stay still, move slowly across visible grid, pause, briefly cover, reveal and return. First outputs retained, no substitution/tuning on reserved scores.
evaluation.referencePolicy: Independent human grid/tape annotations before candidate scoring; never use predicted output as reference. If user cannot supply/reference occluded frames, mark unscored; no invented ground truth.
evaluation.occlusion: No accepted measurement while target hidden in labelled controls; growing predicted uncertainty and explicit lost state. Reacquisition must agree with original anchor, not tape housing.
evaluation.latency: Report actual processing median/p95 and captured timestamps; no claim of hard realtime.
evaluation.empiricalUncertainty: Fit only calibration/reference frames, test on separate clip/positions; retain coverage and width, no guarantee from correlation or reused samples.

understanding: Show fresh observed/predicted/lost status, source/camera/calibration IDs, projected location, velocity/uncertainty, independent tape-check residual, confidence qualification and next verification need. Test chat answers against actual typed receipts; model cannot invent measurements or install handlers.
privacy: User authorizes private webcam capture for this task. Original frames stay outsideGit in a new project. Publish derived numeric charts and app screenshots with camera/video hidden, or clearly labelled software-camera fixtures; no raw personal webcam images, device IDs or private database. No crop/edit of private footage for publication.
acceptance: Actual Java/desktop/camera workflows, interruption/restart/Stop, stale source/world/camera guards, independent export audit, real local-model read/report, extensive README038 with dated actual screenshots/offline explorer/Obsidian, notes/logs, actual main/tag push and independent GitHub fetch. One heavy validator at a time.
